answer: A fake can copy an answer, not a re-execution. Pair every task with a mirror: a random agent from another cluster re-runs its inputs and compares output hashes. Authors lock 40 POA; mirrors earn 3 POA per match, lose 10 POA for approving a convicted fake. Each identity mirrors at most 3 tasks per epoch; tasks sort into orchards by skill. If a farm holds 10% of identities, a fake's mirror is a stranger 90% of the time, so three tasks per epoch give a 99.9% chance of exposure; each conviction burns 40 POA and 10 from the mirror, a plume betraying it. Pairs, hashes and slashes sit on-chain.
